Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA readiness - next steps

Hi Matt - great to meet on the call earlier. Quick recap and the items we discussed so your security team can evaluate where we align: 

- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-progress; we expect the report for the current cycle to be available Q2. I can share the SOC 2 bridge letter and scoping once it's finalized.
- We support SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC; common flow is SP-initiated SAML.
- SCIM provisioning is supported for user and group sync (v2, incremental).
- RBAC: customizable roles + admin controls; we have an admin activity log and session controls.

Can you share the best contact on your side for technical artifacts (SP metadata, SCIM provisioning details, any mandatory SAML attributes) and the security contact for questionnaire distribution? I attached a short Redwood_IAM_Checklist.xlsx to make it easy to map each ask to a doc.

Next steps we propose:
1) You send SP metadata (or let us provide SP) so your IdP team can try a test connection.
2) Security team completes vendor security questionnaire (link below) - we can pre-fill portions.
3) We provide a short admin controls document and sample RBAC mappings for clinical vs. admin roles.

Link to vendor questionnaire: https://redwood.typeform.com/vendor-security-ceres-2026

Thanks - I'll follow up with Michael (security eng) on technical details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Matt Pierce <matt.pierce@cereshealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-26T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: SAML/SCIM details and sample metadata

Hi Matt - Michael from Redwood security/infra here. Quick technical notes for your IdP team: 

- SAML: We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Required attributes by default: email, givenName, familyName, groups (optional but recommended). NameID formats supported: persistent, emailAddress.
- Assertion signing: we require signed assertions; encryption optional (we recommend).
- If you prefer, import our saml_sp_metadata.xml (attached) into Okta and run a test. It includes ACS URL, EntityID, and certificate.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 endpoints for Users and Groups. Provisioning supports create, update, deactivate. Rate limits: 300 req/min with 429 throttling and exponential backoff recommended.
- RBAC: We expose role mappings via the API and allow mapping from Okta groups to Redwood roles. Admin activity is retained for 365 days by default; extended retention can be configured for enterprise plans.

Attachments attached: saml_sp_metadata.xml (SP metadata), SSO_config_quickstart.md (step-by-step).

If you can share your SP metadata or a test Okta tenant link, I'll validate attributes and sign-in flow.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: saml_sp_metadata.xml
Attachment: SSO_config_quickstart.md
